parole.testo: From a Caspian language, probably Mazanderani جفری (jaferi). Cognate with obsolete Transoxianan Persian ژافه (žâfa, “a kind of pungent herb”), dialectal زافه (zâfe, “a kind of Persian shallot”), and Sanskrit जवा (javā, “saffron, rose”).
